$comment: Minimum acceptable scores per fixture for the AI takeoff regression bench (Task #2622). The runner (`scripts/ai-takeoff-bench.mjs`) fails when any fixture's overall metrics regress past `regressionTolerance`, OR when any per-trade metric (`byTrade.<discipline>`) regresses past the same tolerance. Per-trade thresholds prevent a strong score in one trade from masking a regression in another (e.g. M+P, C+L). Keep these conservative on first commit and tighten as the calibration loop feeds real production drift back in.
